mentions.name: GUI coding agent
mentions.description: A GUI-based coding agent the author is considering building, at a tentative idea stage, intended to improve on existing tools like Pi, Herdr, and Paseo, which don't feel right to them. The author is hesitant because succeeding would require writing hundreds of thousands of lines of code.
mentions.problem: Existing GUI coding tools (Pi, Herdr, Paseo) don't feel right to the author, who thinks they could be done better.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm kinda leaning towards vibe coding my own GUI coding agent. I currently use Pi and recently have been playing with Herdr and Paseo, but none of these feels right to me.
